newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid bourse recovers early losses to end flat.
newsitem.headline: Madrid bourse recovers early losses to end flat.

text.p: The Madrid bourse recovered early losses to end broadly flat on Monday after a volatile session which saw stocks pull back after a Socialist victory at French elections at the weekend and amid EMU concerns.
* General index ends 0.45 points down, 0.08 percent, to 547.02 after trading between 552.27 and 537.42.
* Ibex-35 index slips 2.73 points, 0.04 points, 6,298.09 after hitting a low of 6180.02 earlier in the session.
* Turnover remains high with 125 bln pesetas changing hands.
"The market is looking for a level to give it some direction in the short-term amid these high levels of volatility," said one trader.
